rationale: Roberts is most likely to keep the majority together with a narrow Article III standing/redressability opinion that avoids the INA/APA merits and emphasizes third-party causation, resource constraints, and separation-of-powers concerns. Alito is very likely to dissent on standing and argue that APA vacatur of a categorical policy supplies redress and that the INA’s “shall detain” language is judicially enforceable.
